lines.2: 「You're up, Fukahire? We're going to a bathhouse nearby.」
lines.3: 「You should thank me for getting you into your uniform so you wouldn't catch cold.」
lines.5: 「Now that we're refreshed, it is time to get back to work.」
lines.6: 「Good grief. In the end, they're just using us whenever it's convenient.」
lines.7: 「Hey, what did everyone do last night?」
lines.9: 「Why'd you have to say it in such an annoying way?」
lines.10: 「Yashi, we both wore ourselves out sitting in seiza yesterday. I was so sore I could barely move today.」
lines.11: 「I am a little tired too. Sleeping in that position put more strain on my body than I expected.」
lines.12: 「But the Princess is full of energy... Unfair.」
lines.14: 「Wh-what did you do last night?! Now I gotta know! I'm so curious I can't breathe... Hah... hah...」
lines.16: 「All right, men. Time to start cleaning in front of the school gate. I want it gleaming--gleaming, I say!」
lines.17: 「Director, don't we get paid by the hour for this?」
lines.18: 「What an impertinent thing to say, you little chick! Polish your volunteer spirit.」
lines.19: 「Nuaagh, we really are just the errand boys.」
lines.24: 「No grit at all. Where is your manly spirit?」
lines.25: As he spoke, the director scrubbed the school's outer wall clean.
lines.27: What made it truly terrifying was that he'd moved a truck parked in the road off to the side with one hand, just because it was in his way.
lines.28: Don't lump me in with a superhuman like that.
lines.30: Hm? Something sounded noisy over by the pool.
lines.31: The swim team was supposed to be off today.
lines.35: 「All right! Next I'll show you my special kickboard stunt! Just swimming normally gets boring!」
lines.38: 「Wh-- The boys are being worked like prisoners, sweating our guts out, and you get to do this?」
lines.39: 「Well, we finished our quota quickly. Right, Yoppi?」
lines.47: 「Why don't you boys hurry up, finish your work, and come over?」
lines.48: 「Right, of course. Once I'm done, I can come play over here too.」
lines.53: I needed to petition the director so I could come play too.
lines.54: 「Director! The girls are relaxing in the pool!」
lines.56: 「What does it matter? Women and children may splash around. Men work in silence. That's Ryuumeikan quality.」
lines.58: 「Besides, you boys demand your rights far too much without fulfilling your duties.」
lines.59: 「If you still want to go play, then take it by force. Touch me with so much as one finger and I'll let you go.」
